about_block.title: Sam, Sharon and the whole Galatas family
paras: Golden Acres Pizza Market has been a proud member of the Goffstown community serving hearty pizza since 1998. The restaurant is owned and operated by Serafim (Sam) and Sharon Galatas. Sam came to the U.S. to pursue the American Dream from a small village about four hours from Athens.

Over the years almost every member of the Galatas family has helped make Golden Acres a success. Some of our customers have been coming in regularly since the day we opened, and we sponsor many local sports teams. We hope to feed you for years to come.

Navigation has WordPress leftovers: a "#75 (no title)" link, "Style" and "Uncategorized" category links, and a "Hello world!" sample post.
The phone number shows unformatted as 6036230899, twice, in a strip of tiny header links.
The homepage still says "family-owned for 24 years"; the shop opened in 1998.
Footer reads "Fast Food WordPress Theme By Buywptemplate".
The menu page's Order Now button points at a Toast page while the header points at FoodTec; FoodTec is the live one.
The site has 50+ real photos of the food, the owner and the shop sitting unused in its media library.
